title: Decide which sorties a peer base may inspect
goal: A peer base reads only the sorties the owner chose to share over the Kaji line
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-13: all sorties, for any enrolled base
Unknown and revoked bases are refused by the signed link (existing tests in test/kaji-link.test.ts and test/one-channel.test.ts)
The choice is documented in docs/guides/kaji-and-nodes.md
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: Cross-base regression through the signed Kaji call; final applicable CI
escalation: A change to what crosses the Kaji line goes to a fresh-context design review

effort.basis: Decision 2026-11-13: all sorties; no code change, a guide line. Took about 0.1 h agent.
